source: User-attached algebra transcript, all 3564 lines inspected.

new.algebra-modules/full-lattice: Full finite module spanning the ambient fraction-field vector space; distinct from Euclidean and order-theoretic lattices.
new.algebra-modules/lie-order: Bracket-closed full lattice; Lie, not associative, order.
new.algebra-modules/polynomial-module-from-o: Atomic polynomial action construction currently only implicit in rational canonical form pages.
new.algebra-modules/invertible-module: Tensor-invertible module, prerequisite for Picard group over a general commutative ring.
new.algebra-rings/order-in-algebra: General R-order, including the Z-order specialization; quaternion-order is a narrower existing owner.
new.algebra-rings/maximal-order: Maximality among orders; separate from maximal ideals.
new.algebra-commutative/principal-fractional: Extract independently reusable definition embedded in fractional-ideal.
new.algebra-commutative/invertible-fractiona: Invertibility over arbitrary domains; existing fractional-ideal only mentions Dedekind inverses.
new.algebra-commutative/multiplier-ring: Endomorphism order (I:I); no duplicate of analytic multiplier algebra.
new.algebra-commutative/proper-ideal-of-orde: Multiplier-ring equality, explicitly distinguished from ideal strictly smaller than ring.
new.algebra-commutative/conductor-of-order: Largest maximal-order ideal contained in given number-field order.
new.algebra-commutative/picard-group: Tensor group of invertible modules; relates to order class group and reuses number-field ideal-class-group.
new.algebra-rings/brauer-group: Brauer equivalence classes and tensor group operation.
new.algebra-rings/quaternion-reduced-trace: Missing companion to existing conjugation and reduced norm.
new.algebra-rings/pure-quaternion: Trace-zero subspace, used for quaternion rotations.
new.algebra-rings/quaternion-ramification: All places of number field; existing quaternion-real-place-ramification is only real specialization.
new.algebra-rings/hilbert-symbol: Sign-valued local Hilbert symbol, distinguished from algebra presentation notation.
new.algebra-rings/quaternion-discriminant: Product of finite ramified prime ideals.
new.algebra-rings/quaternion-order-discrimin: Reduced discriminant of a quaternion order, distinguished from algebra discriminant.
new.algebra-rings/quaternion-fractional-idea: Left/right full ideal lattices, not commutative fractional ideals.
new.algebra-rings/quaternion-ideal-class-set: Right locally principal ideal classes; class number; no false group structure.
new.algebra-rings/quaternion-type-number: Conjugacy classes of maximal orders, distinguished from ideal classes.
new.algebra-rings/locally-principal-quaterni: Atomic local-principality condition needed for ideal class set.
new.algebra-rings/definite-quaternion-algebr: Totally definite and indefinite convention includes requirement of totally real base.
new.algebra-rings/maximal-subfield: Maximal field subalgebra; distinguish split etale algebra generated by a nonscalar matrix.
new.algebra-rings/quaternion-local-invariant: Quaternion specialization of local Brauer invariant, explicitly distinguished from sign-valued Hilbert symbol.
